summary: Indonesia Energy Corp Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, attaching a June 10 press release updating operational progress at its Kruh Block in Indonesia. The report details that the rig mobilization is complete, the rig was successfully lifted, safety checks finished, and setup is undergoing internal testing, with drilling of the first of two planned wells (K-29) still on schedule for late June 2026. The filing is a routine operational update under Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers, providing a timeline for rig-up, function testing, government inspection, and spud date. No special-situation catalyst such as acquisition, divestiture, or capital return is present; the disclosure merely describes ongoing drilling activities without any transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural changes.
